posts.cooked:
here is the descriptions I wrote down but you posted before me

Blank Slate
White bearded Haka in simple robes praying in a village square while young people stand in the background.

Compassion
Lifeline in decorative robes holding a crooked staff

Crime
Thief Tachyon breaking into a skylight

Defender
high fantasy wizard Alpha/Rowen? Casting a spell

Equality
street cloths Ra lighting a trashcan fire for a homeless man

Fire
flaming Nightmist

Flora and Fauna
moss covered wooden Bunker with toadstool respirators and four red Akash eyes raising out of the swamp

Gearhead
clock-punk Fanatic

Guidance
heroic looking Guise with yellow costume, cape, and “!” chest icon lifting ruble and offering his hand

Honor
military uniform Greezer and alien prisoner standing at a catwalk railing

Inner Demons
Omnitron-X plugged into computer banks in red light

Invulnerable
pink metallic Visionary being struck by green energy beams

Levity
Animal-verse edge twins (Dark Shrike & Pain Stork) ?
She is creating a glowing feather quill, he has hands on his hip laughing

Loner
Setback punching someone in the rain. Drawn by 90’s artist that only uses black, gray, and white ink.

Longevity
Tempest floating through Kirby space sitting on a Kirby-tech chair

Magic
pale skinned head-band Wraith from Dispiration vol.1 issue 4

Prophecy
giant Sky Scraper in Greek toga with a bandaged eye and glowing eye floating over her hand. Tiny figures among ruined columns look on named as “Oracle Sky Scraper” on the letters page

Rage
Oni Mr. Fixer from Dispiration Vol.2 issue 63

Self-Preservation
influencer Young Legacy taking a mid-air selfie above town hall.

Shadow
K.N.Y.F.E. in black and purple costume sneaking towards a vault door

Sidekick
background silhouette of a cosmic captain
foreground Expatriette in Galactra’s costume with glowing power signature guns

Speed
green cheetah (Naturalist) running

Strength
Mecha Fist Unity from Dispiration Vol.2 issue 21

Tactician
American revolutionary war hero Legacy from Dispiration Vol.2 issue 119
reviewing maps with George Washington

Time Traveler
Benchmark in silver plate armor with red visor

Toxicity
glowing green figure in plague doctor kit. Doctor Toxico?

Undead
K.N.Y.F.E. in off duty cloths, patches of skin are missing revealing glowing green bones. A screen in the background says containment breach

Whispers
disheveled long haired Scholar in simple cloths kneeling on a pile of papers covered in symbols and diagrams, a cup of coffee is in arms reach

Wildcard
Argent Adept in kaleidoscopic patchwork motley hanging Seer over a chasm in the realm of Discord

Zealot
over muscled Crono-Ranger with giant cyber arm, a book at his side, bandoleer of shells, and a black parson’s hat

posts.cooked: I think the plague doctor costume on Toxicity scans as a reference to Writhe as much as to Doctor Medico, and this is the only presence any of the SWSentinels/VG have in this set, but I gave it the Absolute Zero slot by way of analogy (we already have an element swap as seen on Fire), because AZ is a Freedom Five member, and even one of those being absent feels conspicuous. Plus Ryan was buddies with Eugene, so fusing them into one person feels like something a Disparation writer would do.

posts.cooked:
The Letters Page folks have the following confirmed as the primary universe heroes represented by the characters on Principle cards:

  • Blank Slate: Haka
  • Compassion: Lifeline
  • Crime: Tachyon
  • Defender: Alpha
  • Equality: Ra
  • Fire: NightMist
  • Flora and Fauna: Bunker
  • Gearhead: Fanatic
  • Guidance: Guise
  • Honor: Greazer
  • Inner Demons: Omnitron-X
  • Invulnerable: the Visionary
  • Levity: Darkstrife and Painstake
  • Loner: Setback
  • Longevity: Tempest
  • Magic: the Wraith
  • Prophecy: Sky-Scraper
  • Rage: Mr. Fixer
  • Self-Preservation: Young Legacy
  • Shadow: Fashion
  • Sidekick: Expatriette
  • Speed: the Naturalist
  • Strength: Unity
  • Tactician: Legacy
  • Time Travel: Benchmark
  • Toxicity: Doctor Medico
  • Undead: K.N.Y.F.E.
  • Whispers: the Scholar
  • Wild Card: the Argent Adept
  • Zealot: Chrono-Ranger

And these actual character names have been confirmed:

  • Fire: NightLight
  • Levity: Darkshrike and Cranestake
  • Magic: The Wraith (not really an alternate name, but it’s their name)
  • Rage: Mr. Fixer (not really an alternate name, but it’s their name)
  • Self-Preservation: Winfluencer
  • Strength: Mecha-Fist
  • Tactician: Legacy (Joseph Parsons)
